title: Add main branch ruleset requiring the four real CI jobs
summary: Step 2 of 5 in the user-approved main-branch migration. Creates a GitHub ruleset on this repo targeting the main branch pattern, requiring the four real CI jobs as status checks: check . eval structure, check . manifests, check . hook tests, check . operating block digest -- matching opum-agent's own live main ruleset shape exactly (strict_required_status_checks_policy: false, do_not_enforce_on_create: false, verified via gh api against opum-agent's actual repository, read-only). Deliberately EXCLUDES two job categories: check . plugin eval (workflow_dispatch-gated, paid, only runs on manual dispatch with a flag -- requiring it would recreate the exact never-reports-on-an-ordinary-SHA trap the promotion-guard jobs are built to avoid, just in a form nobody had seen before this repo's own CI shape), and the two OMARK-29 promotion-guard jobs themselves (promotion-is-manual, main-is-fast-forward-of-dev), which are excluded for the reason documented in both opum-doc's runbook and opum-agent's own workflow file: a job scoped to PRs/pushes against main never reports for dev's tip in any other context, so requiring it would make git push origin dev:main permanently unpushable.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Ruleset targets main, requires exactly the four real CI job context names -- verified by name string, not by guessing -- and matches opum-agent's parameter shape (strict_required_status_checks_policy: false, do_not_enforce_on_create: false).

check . plugin eval is NOT required -- state explicitly, in this task's own record, why: it only runs on manual workflow_dispatch with a paid flag, so an ordinary push/PR SHA never carries a check-run for it, and requiring it would make every future promotion permanently blocked.

Neither promotion-guard job (promotion-is-manual, main-is-fast-forward-of-dev) is required, for the documented reason: each only reports for PRs/pushes against main, never for dev's tip, so requiring either blocks the one correct promotion path.

The ruleset is created before OMARK-31 pushes main into existence, so the very first promotion is already gated by it (do_not_enforce_on_create: false means GitHub checks required contexts even on branch creation, not just updates).

implementationNotes: Ruleset 'require-ci-on-main' (id 22669384) created via gh api POST repos/opum-ai/opum-marketplace/rulesets, matching opum-agent's live ruleset (id 21891439, read via gh api, read-only) parameter-for-parameter: target branch, conditions.ref_name.include ['refs/heads/main'], enforcement active, strict_required_status_checks_policy false, do_not_enforce_on_create false, bypass_actors empty. Required contexts verified BY CODEPOINT from a real completed run (gh run view --json jobs), not by eye, per this repo's own operating block warning about U+00B7 vs ASCII period -- all four job names confirmed to contain U+00B7 (middle dot) at the same position in both the payload and the live run output before posting. Confirmed via gh api repos/.../rules/branches/main afterward that the ruleset applies to the main pattern with exactly these four contexts. check . plugin eval, promotion-is-manual, and main-is-fast-forward-of-dev are all deliberately absent -- reasons recorded in this task's summary and in promotion-guards.yml's own comments (OMARK-29).
references: opum-agent main branch ruleset (read via gh api, read-only)
finalSummary: Ruleset id 22669384 live on opum-ai/opum-marketplace, targeting main, requiring the four real CI jobs, verified by codepoint and by API readback. No repo files changed by this task -- pure GitHub API configuration, so nothing to commit.
